evals.prompt: Add a revenue area chart to my dashboard with a diagonal pattern background that fades out on all sides.
evals.expected_output: Installs @bklit/area-chart and @bklit/background, renders <Background /> as the first child of <AreaChart> with no fade props (fade on all four sides is the default), imports from the project alias, and does not also add <Grid>.
expectations: Runs or instructs running scripts/detect-design.mjs (or reads components.json + globals.css) before writing code
Install command includes @bklit/area-chart and @bklit/background
Uses <Background /> (optionally pattern="diagonal") without setting fadeHorizontal/fadeVertical to false
States or implies that the four-side fade is Background's default rather than inventing a fade prop
Imports from @/components/charts/... paths, never from @bklitui/ui/charts
Does not render <Grid> alongside <Background>
Uses theme tokens (var(--chart-N) / --chart-grid default) with no hardcoded hex colours

evals.prompt: I want squircle bars for monthly signups — like rounded square blocks stacked up, with a ring when you hover.
evals.expected_output: BarChart with squareSnap, BarSquares squareRadius={0.5}, optional BarColumnTrack ghost track with matching squareRadius/squareGap, and ChartTooltip dotVariant="ring" dotRadiusFraction={0.5} showCrosshair={false} (gallery 'Bar Chart - Shape Squircle Ring').
expectations: Uses BarSquares (imported from @/components/charts/bar-squares) with squareRadius={0.5}
Sets squareSnap on BarChart with the same squareGap used on BarSquares
ChartTooltip uses dotVariant="ring" with dotRadiusFraction matching squareRadius (0.5)
Hides the crosshair (showCrosshair={false})
Installs @bklit/bar-chart (BarSquares ships inside it) and @bklit/chart-tooltip
Does not invent props such as shape="squircle" or variant="squircle"

evals.prompt: Make our quarterly sales bars look 3D, like glass blocks.
evals.expected_output: Installs @bklit/bar-depth; renders BarDepthBack before Bar, Bar with perspective, BarDepthFront after Bar, all sharing the same dataKey and a token colour; tooltip without crosshair/dots.
expectations: Install command includes @bklit/bar-depth (and @bklit/bar-chart)
BarDepthBack appears before <Bar> and BarDepthFront after <Bar> in the children
<Bar> has the perspective prop
BarDepthBack color and Bar fill use the same token (e.g. var(--chart-1))
If stacked bars are requested or used, BarDepthProvider wraps the BarChart (not inside it) with segmentsAccessor
Does not add pattern or gradient fills on top of the 3D bars

evals.prompt: Can the area under the traffic line be hatched instead of a gradient? Keep it subtle.
evals.expected_output: PatternLines definition (diagonal, chart colour, strokeWidth 1, 6x6) + PatternArea fill="url(#id)" + Area fillOpacity={0} for the stroke, with a unique pattern id; @bklit/patterns installed.
expectations: Defines a PatternLines pattern imported from @/components/charts/patterns with orientation={["diagonal"]}
Fills via PatternArea fill="url(#...)" (or Area fill="url(#...)") referencing that pattern id
Keeps an Area for the stroke with fillOpacity={0} when PatternArea is used
Pattern stroke uses a theme token (var(--chart-1) or similar), not a hex colour
Uses a unique or prefixed pattern id (e.g. via useId) rather than a generic id
Does not also add a Background pattern behind the hatched area

evals.prompt: While the data loads I want a skeleton state for the line chart, with a shimmer, then animate into the real data.
evals.expected_output: Single LineChart with status={isLoading ? "loading" : "ready"} and loadingLabel; Line loadingStyle="sweep" or Grid shimmer (not both); mentions LineChartLoading as a standalone alternative.
expectations: Uses the status prop on LineChart toggled by the loading state ("loading" | "ready")
Uses loadingStyle="sweep" on Line or Grid shimmer for the shimmer effect
Does not combine loadingStyle="sweep" with Grid shimmer
Does not build a custom animate-pulse div skeleton instead of the chart's loading state
May mention LineChartLoading / BarChartLoading as shortcuts with correct import paths

evals.prompt: Install bklit charts and make them match my brand colours and dark mode.
evals.expected_output: Detects Tailwind v4 + oklch + class dark mode + --radius 1rem; keeps or re-seeds --chart-1..5 from the violet --primary in oklch for both :root and .dark; maps --chart-grid/--chart-label/tooltip tokens to host tokens; confirms @theme inline mappings; picks round bar caps for the 1rem radius.
expectations: Reports Tailwind v4, oklch colour format and class-based dark mode from the fixture
Writes any new chart colours in oklch() (matching the host), not hex or hsl
Provides both light (:root) and dark (.dark) values for every changed --chart-N token
Derives the palette from --primary (violet, hue ~293) or explicitly keeps the host's existing --chart-1..5
Notes that shadcn add will not overwrite existing --chart-* variables
Mentions @theme inline mappings for --color-chart-label / --color-chart-tooltip-* (Tailwind v4)
Maps the 1rem --radius to rounded bar caps (lineCap="round" or squareRadius 0.5)

evals.prompt: Our app is on Tailwind v3 with shadcn. Add a bklit line chart that uses our existing chart colours.
evals.expected_output: Detects Tailwind v3 with bare HSL channel tokens and recharts; explains bklit reads var(--chart-N) as a full colour; scopes a .bklit-chart wrapper with hsl() values plus re-declared --chart-line-primary/secondary and --foreground/--border; adds chart-label/tooltip/legend colours to tailwind.config theme.extend.colors; mentions --color-red-500/emerald-500 only if relevant.
expectations: Identifies that --chart-1..5 are bare HSL channels and would be invalid as var(--chart-N)
Does not rewrite the global --chart-N values (recharts / hsl(var(--chart-N)) usage must keep working)
Uses a scoped wrapper class that sets hsl(...) chart colours for light and dark
Re-declares --chart-line-primary (and secondary) inside the wrapper
Adds chart-label and chart-tooltip-* colours to tailwind.config theme.extend.colors
Does not claim shadcn writes @theme inline mappings on Tailwind v3

evals.prompt: Give the conversion chart a honeycomb background that fades at the edges.
evals.expected_output: States that Background only supports none/diagonal/horizontal/vertical/cross/dots/circles/accent (no hexagons) and that PatternHexagons does not tile cleanly beyond height 1; offers the nearest preset (cross or dots) and/or a small custom HoneycombBackground built from Pattern + a two-gradient fade mask; does not invent pattern="hexagons".
expectations: Explicitly says Background has no hexagon/honeycomb preset
Does not use pattern="hexagons", pattern="honeycomb" or any other non-existent preset
Offers an alternative: a supported preset (e.g. cross or dots) with Background's default fade, and/or a custom composition
If composing manually, uses Pattern/PatternPath (or a correct hex path) from @/components/charts/patterns and a fade mask, reading size from useChart/useChartStable
Keeps the hexagon stroke on var(--chart-grid) or another theme token
